    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the full separator line and compare the two equal-sized panels.
    for r in range(rows):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[r][0] for c in range(cols)):
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]

                         for j in range(cols)] for i in range(len(a))]

                return [[2 if a[i][j] != 0 and b[i][j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(len(a[0]))] for i in range(rows)]
